verdict.rationale: jo's docs say it runs on its own always-available cloud machine. That lets it work overnight, read incoming messages, watch for changes and prepare your morning before you wake. Users can also 'give jo a job and a schedule' and get plans or task reviews back without asking each time, which covers background delegation with results returned. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of ad-hoc delegation of arbitrary multi-step tasks (beyond scheduled jobs and briefings), a defined review/approval step before jo acts, task progress or status visibility, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
